title: "Spatial-Form Treemap"
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

This interactive treemap groups canonical fire uses by spatial form, including camp and settlement areas, mobility corridors, and wetland margins. Within each group, the smaller tiles show individual canonical fire uses.

Click a spatial-form group to focus on its uses. Use the path bar above the tiles to return to a broader view, and hover over a tile to read the complete use label and its associated information.

[Open the figure in a separate browser tab](interactive/spatial-form-treemap.html){target="_blank"}

**My Role:** I grouped the canonical fire-use records by spatial form, created the treemap in R, and refined the tile labels, colours, and tooltips.

**Skills Demonstrated:** Treemap design, hierarchical data organization, and interactive visualization in R.
